title: Adapter
description: Optional known details for one AI tool (TOOL-5): packages/core/adapters/<id>.json. Discovery and integration work without any adapter; an adapter only adds details checked against the tool's own docs.

matches.description: Ids that tool discovery gives this tool (from its own files); the adapter applies to any of them.

format.description: Top-level key the tool's MCP config uses for its servers.

userConfig.description: Per-user config files, first existing one wins (tools move them between versions).

instructionFiles.description: Project files the tool reads instructions from, besides AGENTS.md. A pointer to project memory is written inside a managed block.

startPrompt.description: How the tool, started in a terminal, takes the prompt a fresh session begins with (HND-7). {prompt} is replaced by a fixed sentence pointing at .agents/handoff/next-session.md; no other text reaches the command line. Leave it out when the tool has no documented way: the person then pastes the prompt.

sources.description: Where each detail was checked. At least one.

homePath.description: A path in the user's home folder: starts with ~/, forward slashes, no '..' steps.
